authority: SKILL.md plus current .workflow project truth and exact Git candidate
entry_condition: A scoped Skill Workflow defect, roadmap item, or owner-authorized governance change is selected.
failure_behavior: Any unresolved authority, test, documentation, or truth failure returns the candidate to repair.
Unknown optimization impact expands verification scope rather than assuming safety.
invariants: Generated documentation is never repaired by manual patching.
Roadmap phase and state phase advance in one transaction.
Performance work cannot silently skip final gates.
purpose: Change Skill Workflow source or governance state while preserving exact authority, deterministic documentation, blocking evidence, and roadmap synchronization.
restart_behavior: Resume from the exact branch/SHA and current .workflow state; do not reconstruct authority from chat memory.
rollback_behavior: Revert to the last accepted Git state and preserve failed candidate evidence/history.
title: Governed Skill Workflow change

transitions.action: Make the minimum authorized source/spec change after authority and documentation impact are established.
transitions.authority: current roadmap phase and accepted scope

transitions.action: Run targeted tests, regenerate affected evidence/docs, and execute required governance validation.
Require cumulative tests, exact-candidate governance gates, and explicit evidence boundaries.
side_effects: candidate may be nominated for acceptance

transitions.action: Accept only the exact tested/documented HEAD with clean final provenance.
